text: Every human neuron depends on ATP produced by mitochondria, which descend from ancient bacterial ___ internalized by ancestral eukaryotic cells roughly 1.5 to 2 billion years ago.
explanation: Mitochondria descend from bacterial endosymbionts taken up by ancestral eukaryotic cells around 1.5 to 2 billion years ago, so every act of human neural cognition depends on ATP supplied by these ancient bacterial partners. This is a concrete sense in which the eukaryotic cell, including each neuron, is a biological composite.
